caption_en: Historical PR38 representative profile: the HC-end-to-sparse-start index interval shrinks from 267.399 to 84.607 us, while the sparse kernel changes from 199.736 to 297.362 us. The complete HC-end-to-sparse-end interval improves from 467.136 to 381.970 us. TP0, decode step 2, QSA layer 1; old Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-PTPC-FP8 model, MI308X fc54, ROCm 7.2.4, TP2, 12000 input / 350 output, concurrency 1. caption_en: Historical 2026-10-09 full-model profile: independent packed KV preparation changes HC END to sparse END from 371.554 to 240.398 us. TP0, decode step 2, QSA layer 1; old Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-PTPC-FP8 model, the same fc58 MI308X GPUs 4/5, TP2, 12000 input / 350 output, concurrency 1, fixed 32768-token KV pool. caption_en: Historical 2026-10-09 full-model profile: replacing one-CTA packed attention with PR40 packed split-K attention plus AITER reduction changes the full HC-end-to-final-attention-end interval from 240.398 to 104.275 us. Prepare remains 7.210 versus 7.209 us; the old 153.147 us packed attention is replaced by a 10.856 us main kernel and a 5.967 us reduction kernel. Upstream index through current-token KV store is 80.039 versus 80.240 us. TP0, decode step 2, QSA layer 1; old Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-PTPC-FP8 model, the same fc58 MI308X GPUs 4/5, TP2, 12000 input / 350 output, concurrency 1, fixed 32768-token KV pool. HC is displayed separately and excluded. These are representative GPU intervals from separate profiles.
limits: Old model and 32768-token pool; not the PLE-BF16 262144-token pool campaign.
